description: OFFER DEADLINE OF WEDNESDAY, JUNE 3RD AT 5 PM! Welcome to this spectacular fully renovated and turnkey two-story home on the market for the first time in 32 years. Consisting of a spacious 3,100 sq. ft. residence with 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths on a large 10,000+ sq ft lot. Upon entry, you are immediately greeted with a designer kitchen featuring white oak cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a welcoming center island, all of which are overlooking the tranquil views of the lush backyard greenery and sparkling pool.  The remodeled kitchen is the perfect backdrop for cooking and gathering. Outdoors, the grounds feel like a private retreat. Designed with serenity in mind, the yard includes multiple seating areas, a newly redone pool, and a covered patio ideal for outdoor dining and gatherings. The home also features brand new wide plank flooring throughout the home,  a well-laid-out floor plan, and lots of natural light throughout.  The home offers five generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a spa-inspired bathroom complete with a soaking tub, a separate shower, and double vanity.  In addition to the home's attached 2 car garage, there is a double car carport in the side yard suitable for a possible ADU conversion (buyer to investigate).  Truly a one-of-a-kind opportunity with unmatched possibilities. Just some of the home's highlights are a new kitchen, updated bathrooms, floors, paint, replastered pool, and fresh lawn.  With the home's generously sized circular driveway, there is parking available for 7+ cars. This is the ultimate home for a family.  Located within walking distance from the worship temples and the gold rated Sherman Oaks Center for Enriched Studies (#5 In the LAUSD), and within minutes from the shops and restaurants along Ventura Blvd. This beautiful home will go Super Fast!
